verdict.rationale: Kong is not a workflow-automation product. Its closest analog is config-as-code: decK provides APIOps lifecycle automation from a CLI, and Kong supports declarative (DB-less) configuration alongside the Admin API. Both imply gateway config can be kept in files and versioned externally, but the pack never documents versioning, review/diff, or rollback directly. Missing for 10: explicit versioning of configs, diff/review workflow before applying changes, documented rollback to prior config states, any hands-on corroboration.
